Yes — Mira has a confirmed egg allergy (mild hives), noted by Riverdale Pediatrics. That's the one to flag to any new caregiver, along with what to watch for and what's helped before.

Worth including in a caregiver note:

- Egg is the trigger, reaction has been mild hives so far.
- What to avoid: egg and obvious egg-containing foods (baked goods, mayo, etc.).
- What to do if hives appear: contact you right away; if anything beyond mild hives (swelling, trouble breathing), call 911 and then you.

Want me to draft a short caregiver hand-off note with this plus her bedtime routine and comfort object?
